title: Reader--Writer Coupling in Transformer MLPs
abstract: arXiv:2610.29340v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A transformer MLP gives each hidden channel two roles: a reader that decides when the channel responds, and a writer that decides what it adds back to the residual stream. Read as a key--value memory, the layer can be measured one factor set at a time: the pairing of readers to writers is carried only by their shared index, invisible to any quantity computed from one factor set alone. Yet training couples the two factors through their joint update, so we ask what reading them together shows. The block supplies the joint instrument: the MLP writes back into the very stream it reads, so the exact Jacobian of its update is square, and its agreement with its own transpose resolves into reader--writer terms whose inner products give each channel, read as a couple, a signed pairing coordinate. translated_title: Transformer MLP中的读取器—写入器耦合
translated_abstract: Transformer的MLP为每个隐藏通道赋予两种角色：读取器决定该通道何时响应，写入器决定该通道向残差流中加回什么内容。若将此层视为键—值记忆来读取，则可以一次测量一个因子集：读取器与写入器之间的配对仅由它们共享的索引承载，任何仅从单一因子集计算出的量都无法看到这种配对。然而，训练通过联合更新将这两个因子耦合在一起，因此我们探究将二者一同读取能够揭示什么。该模块本身提供了联合测量的工具：MLP写回到它所读取的同一个流中，因此其更新的精确雅可比矩阵是方阵，它与自身转置的一致性可以分解为读取器—写入器项，其内积为每个通道（作为一个耦合对来读取）给出一个带符号的配对坐标。按此坐标排序，我们所测量的每个模块都拥有一个由强耦合通道组成的小核心；在初始化使两种符号等概率出现之处……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将Transformer MLP中隐藏通道的读取器与写入器视为耦合对进行联合测量，利用MLP更新雅可比矩阵与自身转置的一致性导出带符号的配对坐标，并据此发现每个模块仅由一小部分强耦合通道构成核心。
en_tdlr: This paper jointly measures reader-writer coupling in Transformer MLP hidden channels via signed pairing coordinates derived from the agreement between the MLP's update Jacobian and its own transpose, revealing that each block possesses a small core of strongly coupled channels.
